Item Description

Supermicro AS-1014S-WTRT 1U Server | No CPU | No RAM | No Drives | Dual PSU

This Supermicro AS-1014S-WTRT (813TS-R5H12) 1U server delivers outstanding performance for virtualization, cloud computing, and high-performance workloads.
System includes no CPU, redundant power supplies, and all essential components — no memory or drives installed, giving you full control over your configuration.
Professionally handled and backed by a 1-Year Warranty.

Key Features

  • Chassis Model: Supermicro 813TS-R5H12

  • Motherboard: AS-1014S-WTRT (H12 Series)

  • Processor: No CPU supports 64-Core / 128-Thread @ 2.0 GHz (Base), 3.35 GHz (Boost), 256 MB Cache, 200 W TDP

  • Memory: No RAM installed – supports up to 2 TB DDR4-3200 ECC RDIMM/LRDIMM

  • Drive Bays: 4 x 3.5? Hot-Swap SATA3 Bays (empty, no drives installed)

  • Storage Controller: Onboard SATA3 (software RAID 0/1 support)

  • Network: Dual 10GBase-T LAN ports (Broadcom BCM57416 controller)

  • Expansion: 2 x PCI-E 4.0 x16 (FHFL) + 1 x PCI-E 4.0 x16 (LP)

  • Power Supply: Dual 500 W Platinum-Level Redundant PSUs

  • Cooling: Redundant hot-swap fans

  • Form Factor: 1U Rackmount

  • Warranty: 1 Year Replacement

Technical Specifications

  • Processor Family: AMD EPYC 2nd Gen “Rome”

  • Socket: SP3 (Single Socket Design)

  • Memory Capacity: Up to 2 TB DDR4-3200 ECC RDIMM/LRDIMM

  • Storage Interface: SATA3 (6 Gb/s) / NVMe support via optional kit

  • Networking: Broadcom BCM57416 Dual 10GBase-T

  • IPMI Management: Integrated IPMI 2.0 + KVM (no OOB license included)

  • USB Ports: 4 rear USB 3.0 + 1 Type-A

  • Video Output: 1 VGA

  • Power Input: 100–240 V AC, 50/60 Hz

Compatible With

  • AMD EPYC 7002 / 7003 Series Processors

  • Supermicro H12 Series Motherboards

  • VMware, Hyper-V, and Proxmox virtualization environments

  • Enterprise data-center and HPC applications

Ideal For

  • Virtualization clusters and private cloud deployments

  • AI and machine learning projects

  • High-performance computing (HPC) applications

  • Enterprise labs and custom server builds

  • ITAD and reseller inventory projects

Why Buy From Us

  • Supermicro and AMD EPYC hardware experts

  • Professionally handled and securely packaged systems

  • Fast, reliable U.S.-based shipping

  • Volume and reseller pricing available on request
